upsell.title: Premium feature
upsell.description: Search cards up for trade near you by language, foil, minimum condition, price range and distance, sorted by proximity or price.

filters.priceNote: The price is the one set by the owner or, if missing, the market value. It's only indicative: you agree on it between yourselves.

results.noLocation: set your location in your profile to filter by distance
results.truncated: too many results: narrow your search
results.emptyDescription: Try increasing the distance or removing some filters.
